author: nickyeow

english.text: What? It's only eleven? We still have an hour to go before lunch.

jyutping: me1 waa2？ji4 gaa1 sin1 sap6 jat1 dim2 zaa3？zung6 jau5 sing4 lap1 zung1 sin1 sik6 faan6 wo3。
text: 咩話？而家先十一點咋？仲有成粒鐘先食飯喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You should learn to restrain yourself.

jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 hok6 haa5 hung3 zai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 cing4 seoi5。
text: 你應該學吓控制自己嘅情緒。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I must apologize to Ann.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tung4 aa3 Ann gong2 deoi3 m4 zyu6。
text: 我一定要同阿 Ann 講對唔住。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When did you get back from London?

jyutping: nei5 gei2 si4 hai2 leon4 deon1 faan2 faan2 lai4 gaa3？
text: 你幾時喺倫敦返返嚟㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: We've been having strange weather the past few years.

jyutping: nei1 gei2 nin4 di1 tin1 hei3 hou2 m4 zing3 soeng4。
text: 呢幾年啲天氣好唔正常。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Your face is black. Did you come from a coal mine?

jyutping: nei5 faai3 min6 wu1 zeot1 zeot1 gam2 ge3，heoi3 jyun4 mui4 kong3 lai4 aa3？
text: 你塊面烏卒卒噉嘅，去完煤礦嚟呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: How long did it take you to translate this book?

jyutping: nei5 jik6 ne1 bun2 syu1 jik6 zo2 gei2 noi6 aa3？
text: 你譯呢本書譯咗幾耐呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: This beefsteak smells good.

jyutping: ne1 faai3 ngau4 paa2 hou2 hoeng1。
text: 呢塊牛扒好香。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What will you do after graduation?
What'll you do after graduation?

jyutping: nei5 bat1 zo2 jip6 zi1 hau6 nam2 zyu6 zou6 di1 me1 aa3？
text: 你畢咗業之後諗住做啲咩呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: People often take me for my brother.

jyutping: di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 jing6 co3 ngo5 zou6 ngo5 aa3 go1。
text: 啲人成日認錯我做我阿哥。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll give you a day to think about it.

jyutping: ngo5 bei2 jat1 jat6 si4 gaan1 nei5 haau2 leoi6。
text: 我俾一日時間你考慮。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Comb your hair before you go out.

jyutping: so1 hou2 nei5 di1 tau4 faat3 sin1 hou2 ceot1 mun4 hau2 aa1。
text: 梳好你啲頭髮先好出門口呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Whatever you say, I'll do it my way.

jyutping: nei5 jau5 nei5 gong2，ngo5 jau5 ngo5 zou6。
text: 你有你講，我有我做。

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm available in case you need something.

jyutping: jau5 me1 seoi1 jiu3 ngo5 wui5 hai2 dou6。
text: 有咩需要我會喺度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Let's try to make our own turnip cakes for Chinese New Year!" "That sounds like a good idea, but I'm too lazy to cook."

jyutping: 「gam1 go3 san1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5 zi6 gei2 zing2 lo4 baak6 gou1 sik6 lo1！」「ngo5 dou1 soeng2 aa3，bat1 gwo3 hou2 ci5 hou2 daai6 gung1 cing4 gam3 wo3。」
text: 「今個新年我哋不如試吓自己整蘿蔔糕食囉！」「我都想呀，不過好似好大工程咁喎。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: The street was dark.

jyutping: tiu4 gaai1 hou2 am3。
text: 條街好暗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I get the feeling that no one here is telling us the truth.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 ne1 dou3 di1 jan2 dou1 hai2 dou3 ngaak1 gan2 ngo5 dei6 gam3。
text: 我覺得好似呢到啲人都喺到呃緊我哋咁。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Which is worse, killing one person or letting five people die?

jyutping: saat3 sei2 jat1 go3 jan4 caa1 di1，ding6 hai6 jau2 dak1 ng5 go3 jan4 sei2 caa1 di1？
text: 殺死一個人差啲，定係由得五個人死差啲？

author: alishalikescats

english.text: I didn't argue with Tom.

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 tung4 aa3 Tom cou4 gaau1。
text: 我冇同阿Tom嘈交。

english.text: Every February, I, along with many others across the nation, commemorate Black History Month and celebrate an important aspect of my diverse cultural heritage. Like most Americans, I’m the sum of many parts, an amalgam of intersecting identities. I am Black, a woman and a proud disabled veteran, to name a few. The intersectionality of my heritage and lived experiences is unique to me and makes me who I am.

jyutping: mui5 nin4 ji6 jyut6，ngo5 dou1 wui5 tung4 cyun4 gwok3 hou2 do1 kei4 taa1 jan4 jat1 cai4 gei2 nim6 hak1 jan4 lik6 si2 jyut6，tung4 maai4 hing3 zuk1 ngo5 do1 jyun4 faa3 ge3 man4 faa3 wai4 caan2 ge3 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 fong1 min6，tung4 daai6 bou6 fan6 mei5 gwok3 jan4 jat1 joeng6，ngo5 hai6 hou2 do1 bou6 fan6 ge3 zung2 wo4，hai6 jat1 go3 gaau1 caa1 ge3 san1 fan2 ge3 wan6 hap6 mat6 ，jat1 go3 neoi5 jan4 tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 zi6 hou4 ge3 caan4 zat6 teoi3 ng5 gwan1 jan4，zi2 hai6 gaai3 siu6 gei2 go3，ngo5 ge3 wai4 caan2 tung4 ging1 lik6 ge3 gaau1 caa1 sing3 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 duk6 jat1 mou4 ji6 ge3，ling6 ngo5 sing4 wai4 ngo5 ge3 jan4。
text: 每年二月，我都會同全國好多其他人一齊紀念黑人歷史月，同埋慶祝我多元化嘅文化遺產嘅一個重要方面，同大部分美國人一樣，我係好多部分嘅總和，係一個交叉嘅身份嘅混合物 ，一個女人同埋一個自豪嘅殘疾退伍軍人，只係介紹幾個，我嘅遺產同經歷嘅交叉性對我嚟講係獨一無二嘅，令我成為我嘅人。

english.text: A perfect person should emulate the virtue of the tree. The more the tree grows, the more beautiful and delicate it becomes, but the harder and stronger it becomes within.

jyutping: jat1 go3 bong2 joeng6 ge3 jan4 jing1 goi1 mou4 fong2 jat1 fo2 syu6 ge3 mei5 dak1。 keoi5 jyu6 zoeng2，zau6 wui5 jyu6 leng3 jyu6 jyun5，daan6 hai6 keoi5 noi6 sam1 zau6 wui5 jyu6 ngaang6 jyu6 ging6。
text: 一個榜樣嘅人應該模仿一棵樹嘅美德。 佢愈長，就會愈靚愈軟，但係佢內心就會愈硬愈勁。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Heaven keep us from a knowledge of the sights the moon beheld upon that field, when, coming up above the black line of distant rising-ground, softened and blurred at the edge by trees, she rose into the sky and looked upon the plain, strewn with upturned faces that had once at mothers' breasts sought mothers' eyes, or slumbered happily.

jyutping: tin1 tong4 ling6 ngo5 dei6 m4 zi1 dou3 jyut6 loeng6 hai2 go2 faai3 tin4 je5 soeng6 min6 so2 gin3 dou2 ge3 ging2 sik1，dong1 keoi5 hai2 jyun5 fong1 sing1 hei2 ge3 hak1 sik1 sin3 soeng6 min6，hai2 syu6 muk6 ge3 bin1 jyun4 bin3 dak1 jyun5 faa3 tung4 mou4 wu4 ge3 si4 hau6，keoi5 sing1 soeng6 tin1 hung1，mong6 zyu6 ping4 jyun4，mong6 zyu6 ping4 jyun4，soeng6 min6 saan3 lok6 zo2 jat1 di1 joeng5 hei2 ge3 min6 hung2，cang4 ging1 hai2 mou5 can1 ge3 jyu5 fong4 dou6 cam4 zaau2 mou5 can1 ge3 ngaan5 zing1，waak6 ze2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 fan3 gaau3。
text: 天堂令我哋唔知道月亮喺嗰塊田野上面所見到嘅景色，當佢喺遠方升起嘅黑色線上面，喺樹木嘅邊緣變得軟化同模糊嘅時候，佢升上天空，望住平原，望住平原，上面散落咗一啲仰起嘅面孔，曾經喺母親嘅乳房度尋找母親嘅眼睛，或者開心噉瞓覺。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The King, his father, who was a good man, believed him; but his mother could not be persuaded that it was true; and seeing that he went almost every day a-hunting, and that he always had some excuse ready for so doing, though he had been out three or four nights together, she began to suspect that he was married.

jyutping: gwok3 wong4，keoi5 ge3 fu6 can1，hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jan4，soeng1 seon3 keoi5；daan6 hai6 keoi5 aa3 maa1 m4 ho2 ji5 seoi3 fuk6 dou3 keoi5 hai6 zan1 ge3；ji4 gin3 dou2 keoi5 gei1 fu4 mui5 jat6 dou1 heoi3 daa2 lip6，ji4 ce2 keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 di1 zik6 hau2 zeon2 bei6 hou2 gam3 zou6，seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 heoi3 zo2 saam1、sei3 maan5，keoi5 hoi1 ci2 waai4 ji4 keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1。
text: 國王，佢嘅父親，係一個好人，相信佢；但係佢阿媽唔可以說服到佢係真嘅；而見到佢幾乎每日都去打獵，而且佢成日都有啲藉口準備好咁做，雖然佢哋一齊出去咗三、四晚，佢開始懷疑佢結咗婚。
